      Review window: Aug 26, 2026 - Sep 3, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _khaldonalsalami_, Sep 1, 2026, 1/5: "useless just want to cancel subscription"

When encountering technical questions, subscription management concerns, or account-specific dashboard issues, getting a clear, timely, and effective resolution can be frustrating. Often, responses feel slow or lack the specific context needed to resolve account-related hurdles smoothly."
